entries.what: Thao sleeps until mid-afternoon after Saturday's shift, then reviews the go-live prep emails and walks the Ulloa marsh boardwalk loop before work.
entries.outcome: Arrives at St. Anselm rested enough, parks in the gravel overflow lot and takes the shuttle.

entries.what: Night shift on 4 West before the switchover; Maribel walks the staff through paper backup forms and Rubén hints he will share his shortcuts.
entries.outcome: Unit is stocked with downtime forms for the go-live.

entries.what: Sleeps after the night shift, then takes the shuttle up Ortega Hill for St. Anselm's charting go-live, the first day on the new system; the unit is slow and crowded with trainers.
entries.outcome: Agrees to take a fourth night this week during go-live coverage.

entries.what: Overnight on 4 West, Rubén shares his laminated cheat sheet of charting shortcuts and Thao uses it all shift while waits and overtime build.
entries.outcome: Gets through the first go-live night with the sheet taped by her workstation.

entries.what: Home at 7:45 a.m. after go-live night one, she writes down the downtime procedures that tripped people up and asks for a clean checklist.
entries.outcome: Has a one-page downtime checklist printed to carry in her badge pocket.

entries.what: Sleeps with the box fan and blackout curtains until 3 p.m., then packs rice and leftovers and makes her cà phê sữa đá thermos.
Second go-live night on 4 West; Ruben's sheet gets passed to a nurse who is new to the system.
entries.outcome: Fewer chart errors than the first night.

entries.what: At 8 a.m. after her third night, she gets a long explanation of a charting workflow and answers that it is too long and she needs just the steps.
entries.outcome: Gets a short numbered list and goes to bed.

entries.what: Sleeps until the afternoon, then does laundry with the reloadable card in the Marisol Gardens laundry room.
Hears the baby crying through the wall from 209 and puts in earplugs with white noise before a nap.
Day off; Thao runs errands at Ruiz Family Market for fish sauce and produce and avoids a call from her mother.
entries.outcome: Fridge is stocked for the weekend.

entries.what: Texting with Jasmine about the week, she admits she has a lingering crush on Dr. Mehta's polite voice on night pages, then laughs it off.
entries.outcome: Jasmine teases her but promises to keep it quiet.

entries.what: Early evening, she watches her baking show and goes to bed early before Saturday's shift.
Sleeps most of the day, with street fair music from Calle Ortega faintly audible, then skips the fair to get ready for her fourth night this week.
entries.outcome: Passes on the Calle Ortega Street Fair; leaves with thermos and packed rice.

entries.what: Saturday night on 4 West, busy with go-live fallout; Ruben's sheet and the downtime checklist get used again.
entries.outcome: Charts caught up by shift end.

entries.what: After shift, she and Jasmine get phở tái at Phở Bến Thành at 8 a.m.
Waking in the afternoon, she sees 23 unheard voicemails piled up, mostly from her mother, and asks the assistant for a way to read them as text.
entries.outcome: Sets up voicemail transcription and answers by text instead of calling anyone.

entries.what: Evening of quiet at home with a pothos check on the balcony and a text to Linh about the week.
entries.outcome: Linh says she is fine and gets a nudge to eat lunch.

new_facts.subject: thao
new_facts.value: taped Rubén's cheat sheet and a downtime checklist by her workstation

new_facts.subject: thao
new_facts.value: skipped the Calle Ortega Street Fair because of her Saturday night shift
